End-to-End Infrastructure Execution for India
INTRODUCTION
Broadway Links Pvt. Ltd. (BLPL), incorporated under the companies Act, 1956 (No. 1 of 1956) in 2001, an ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 & 14001: 2015 certified is headquartered in Begusarai, Bihar, India. BLPL's businesses span the sectors of Construction & Infrastructure.
Founded by Industrialist Ajay Kumar Singh, the group is a renowned business conglomerate with successful entities spread across industries- Construction & Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Stone Aggregate Mining & Crushing, Iron & Steel- Furnace/Rolling Mill, Petroleum Retailing and Real State for more than 30 Years in the state of Bihar, Jharkhand and UP with the latest addition of dual Grain based Ethanol production. Overall entities have achieved outstanding business growth within a short span of time. 
BLPL is committed to its quality, environmental and occupational health and safety management systems. 
BLPL has got a current order book of Rs. 1233.7 Crores, from RCD & WRD- Got. Of Bihar, IOCL Barauni Refinery, TEN Noida, McDermott Gurgaon, PRODAIR AIR PRODUCT India with balance work of Rs. 301.1 Crores and rigorously bidding to increase its strong presence and become one of the most successful construction & infrastructure companies of this decade.
Company has entered into direct orders in Oil & Gas including but not limited to Piling, Civil Structure, Mechanical Works (Successful Erection of Steam Methane Reformer of capacity 6.25 Ton/Hr. & Gaseous Nitrogen around 4000 NM3/ hr.), AG/UG Piping, Structural Steel Supply/Fabrication/ Painting/Erection (Pipe Rack, Technological Structures, Compressor Shelters, Equipment Platforms), Fire Proofing, Roads & Highways, Irrigation & Canal Lining works, from various PSU such as Indian Oil Corporation Limited and departments of Govt. of Bihar, Jharkhand after going through national competitive bidding.
We feel proud to own fleet of automated construction equipment of make JCB, SANY, BEML, VOLVO, Ingersoll-Rand, Caterpillar, Komatsu, L&T, Apollo, KYB Conmat, Schwing Stetter, METSO, Atlas Copco, Ashok Leyland, TATA to name a few and leads in fleet ownership in the state of Bihar.
BLPL has worked with best of the Clients and Leading Infrastructure companies of high repute in Oil & Gas and Roads & Highways and pride itself to be part of ongoing National Growth with successful completion of Projects worth Rs. 2293 Crores over past 25 years.
BLPL's history as an organization reflects the spirit of entrepreneurship, a far-sighted vision, dynamic leadership, and ability to overcome adversity and take calculated risks, teamwork by committed professionals, and agility to take advantage of emergent opportunities.
